predecessor.scope: Actual linked DOS engine/adapter/file owner/watchdog/UART ISR with modeled BIOS clock, serial peer and DOS kernel. Fixed38400 DTE; no instruction/callback replacement. Immediate, delayed, quoted full-window, direct, cancellation, loss and no-progress bounds. Not an actual audio, BBS or physical acceptance.

build/terminal/zmodem-upload-response-ch.scope: Actual linked DOS engine/adapter/file owner/watchdog/UART ISR with modeled BIOS clock, serial peer and DOS kernel. Fixed38400 DTE; no instruction/callback replacement. Immediate, delayed, quoted full-window, direct, cancellation, loss and no-progress bounds. Not an actual audio, BBS or physical acceptance.

build/terminal/config-far-checks.json.scope: Serialized DOS MZ and linker-map validation of 34 explicit near-cdecl entries including zero and ten arguments, ten compiler register callbacks, 24 resident word-cdecl callbacks and twelve explicit zero-argument callbacks and ten typed far ZMODEM callback pointers; exact argument-copy frames, target calls/returns, relocations and full configuration C extent. Independent CPU candidate/directory/owner suites and actual DOS child allocation exercise behavior.

build/terminal/far-code-live-checks.json.scope: Actual linked near/far bridges, controller, PRN queue and UART ISR; kernel/hardware modeled. MZ pointer/return/relocation and segment bounds checked independently, including rejection mutations. DOS child memory retention is a separate actual DOS test. Not arbitrary C stack-argument bridging or full application segmentation.

build/terminal/ymodem-far-checks.json.scope: Actual linked migrated codec/framing and source-owned adapters. Independent decimal/CRC peers, actual register/FLAGS and stack observations at C/near/far returns. Compiler object import normalization checked by inverse transform and independent Open Watcom disassembly; malformed records fail closed. Only DOS/BIOS/UART boundaries modeled; actual DOS and source-only rebuild evidence remain separate.

build/terminal/terminal-zmodem-live-chec.scope: Actual linked CONFIG_CODE engine/codec/far callback table, checked batch storage/source seek, serviced physical UART ISR and foreground owner. Independent exact Python wire scripts; only hardware/BIOS/DOS kernel boundaries modeled. Not actual DOS/BBS or physical modem evidence.

build/terminal/zmodem-cancel-checks.json.scope: Actual linked foreground owner, ZMODEM engine, storage, UART ISR and cancel writer; BIOS clock/keyboard/ports and DOS filesystem boundaries modeled. Late input and endless-input deadline checked; real BBS cancellation is separate.

build/terminal/zmodem-completed-replay-c.scope: Actual linked receiver, file owners, UART ISR and bounded owner. Peer requires no replies to already committed in-flight data, full closing-header/OO consumption, one install and intact APP tail. Hardware/kernel and carrier pacing modeled. No real audio/BBS or physical acceptance.

build/terminal/carrier-transfer-deadline.scope: Linked production receiver, watchdog, UART ISR and storage. Hardware/kernel boundaries modeled. Quantized1200/300-bps wire time plus idle clock, not audio or physical acceptance. Fixed DTE remains unchanged; unknown modem carrier uses bounded300bps packet allowance, direct sessions retain UART allowance. Historical failure retained separately.

build/zmodem-link-policy/checks.json.scope: Strict C89 host engine, typed carrier-floor ABI and independent reactive Python wire/CRC peer. Exact file, bounded overlap, genuine polls, reply requests at zero/300/1200/65535bps policies, invalid policy rejects before side effects. Not DOS, audio or physical evidence.

build/zmodem-completion-bounds/checks.js.scope: Maintained C component compiled with strict C89 in pinned Nix; ctypes file/transport callbacks modeled. Thirteen rejection/limit/flow cases preserve one checked file and cannot infer actual DOS/audio or physical acceptance.

build/zmodem-session/checks.json.scope: Maintained session engine with host transport/storage callbacks and independent pinned lrzsz pipes; optional selected stock Synchronet sexyz stdio helper uses two nonempty files only. No DOS filesystem/16-bit callback ABI, terminal UART/UI, physical modem or BBS session claim.

build/zmodem-window/checks.json.scope: Independent reactive Python CRC/header/data peer; host C callbacks, full duplex/overlap and finite-capacity policy, delayed/fragmented/stale ACK, window and buffer invariants, midstream/EOF recovery, future ACK, raw CAN and confirmed-progress separation. No actual DOS/UART/BBS or physical timing claim.

build/zmodem-dos/checks.json.scope: Actual source-built 8086 DOS session engine with far callbacks and real checked receive filesystem owner. Wire input is scripted, source callbacks diagnostic stdio; not the terminal source/transport/UI adapter or a live DOS UART/BBS session.

scope: Native buffered-modem sender response fix with linked hardware/kernel models, strict C89 independent wire peers, real DOS component and actual DOS automatic three-file checks. Eight delayed/immediate completion cases, four native timeout/cancel/loss cleanup cases and two deliberately stopped unchanged-policy witnesses. Same checker reproduces the predecessor failure. All original capture failures remain failures. No new actual audio upload, physical or F01-F16 acceptance.
